text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami, how did that thing
you asked me about go?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You mean the time I broke the doorknob!
Just as you said, putting a plant in my room
seems to have given me true peace of mind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm! Houseplants have the power to soothe negative energy, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you've got any troubles, Akebono,
I can solve them Copa-style with Feng Shui! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me? Well, let's see~
Nothing really comes to mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, come to think of it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heeave-hooo!!
Every single corner is spotless now, yes~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is all for my dear friend!
Oooohhh!! May my prayers for her victory be answered!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
The table is sparkling clean too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The sink is sparkling too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ricky-chan, is this alright?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Keeping your surroundings clean attracts good luck for sweepstakes!
It's totally sound feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you~!
I'm starting to feel like that meal voucher for the famous chanko nabe restaurant might actually be within reach~☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I've finished cleaning over here as well!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's here!
All right, let's go apply right away!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Ughhh, what a shame!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, we couldn't break through the winning probability barrier, could we?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You can't change the predetermined winning odds, but you can change your luck—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I thought taking it on with positive qi would work, but...
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all~☆
The cafe got all cleaned up, so that's a good thing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is it! My arms are completely pumped, making for splendid training!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Ah, there they are, the kids from earlier!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh, about us...?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
"You even made the stubborn grease stains sparkle!
It was truly a lifesaver~."

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
So, here are meal vouchers for a restaurant
run by an acquaintance of mine.
Please, feel free to use them with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
C-Could this be... a meal voucher
for a chankonabe restaurant!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ahaha♪
Cleaning up really did bring good luck, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ricky-chan, please let me ask for your advice again sometime♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...And that's the story!
I'm just glad I could help!

Before training, Copano Rickey shared
a heartwarming story about her classmates.

So feng shui actually helped, huh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ahaha♪ That's for sure!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Those two laugh so much and are so full of energy.
Whenever I'm with them,
I feel like I'm the one getting energized!

Perhaps the three of them, all powerful in their own ways,
have a lot in common.
I hoped they would continue getting along well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll keep honing
my Feng Shui skills!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to bring lots and lots
of happiness to my precious friend♪"
